notes: Smart Pipeline reliability update. The selected-prospect pipeline now uses a continuous four-worker queue instead of chunk barriers, uses the resilient per-company processor already proven by Smart Finder, retries temporary service failures without stopping the whole batch, isolates bad prospects, checkpoints every completed company, and reports a live rate-based ETA with confidence and heartbeat health. Paused jobs now stop the progress UI cleanly instead of appearing stuck, with completed work preserved.
